messages:
maria: Quick async check — Rotterdam (nl-west-3) rollout status? I need a short owner list for egress routing, KMS residency, and the remaining PRs blocking canary. Can folks ping owners and TL;DR current blockers? :eyes:
pranav: Owners: networking -> sasha, infra/kms -> lisa, routing policies -> thomas. I'm the PM for the cutover timeline.
sasha: 2 quick items from networking side: 1) egress route policy PR pending (net team review), 2) BGP session still needs confirmation from GCP peering. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/3245
lisa: KMS side: key rotation policy doc merged, HSM proofs in progress. Waiting on infra PR to wire kms key id into proxy config — @pranav can we delay rotation until after canary?
pranav: yes, delay rotation until after canary to reduce blast radius. Schedule looks like: canary -> 24h telemetry -> full cutover. Canary target: 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC.
thomas: routing PR needs small change from @sasha (policy precedence). I'll leave a review comment now. Also we need a fallback model for high-latency clients: route to eu-central fallback pool.
sasha: ack, will update precedence in PR. Also adding a fallback tag: ``fallback_region: eu-central`` in policy yaml.
net-bot: BGP session check: peerings-ok for nl-west-3: false. Waiting on peer ASN confirmation from cloud partner. Ticket: NET-712
pranav: NET-712 noted. Sasha can you escalate with the partner and add a contact?
sasha: pinged partner via email (contact: peering-support@partnercloud.example). Added contact in NET-712.
thomas: small config snippet for reviewers — please check precedence and KV ordering before approving:
```
route_policies:
  - name: nl-west-3-egress
    precedence: 100
    match: client.residency == "nl"
    actions:
      - set_egress: nl-west-3
      - fallback: eu-central
```
pranav: blocker list (TL;DR): 1) NET-712 peering, 2) infra PR to inject kms id, 3) routing precedence review, 4) smoke tests flaky on canary image (flaky test id: smoke-conn-timeout).
lisa: for #2 I can fast-track infra PR review but need a small unit test change — will open a follow-up PR this afternoon.
thomas: will finish routing review in next 30m. @deploy-bot can you hold canary deployment until I approve?
deploy-bot: Canary hold applied to nl-west-3. Deployment will not proceed without manual override.
sasha: partner replied: ASN mismatch fixed, peering scheduled 2026-04-02 07:00 UTC. NET-712 updated.
pranav: thanks. Action items: sasha escalate peering + verify post-peering connectivity, lisa open follow-up PR for kms wiring, thomas finish routing review, infra to retry smoke tests after canary image rebuild. Can everyone add a tiny status update to this thread when done? :thumbsup:
maria: thanks team — please add who will be on-call for the 4/5 canary window. I can cover escalation but would like a network lead and infra lead assigned.
sasha: I'll be network on-call for the window.
lisa: infra/KMS on-call assigned to me.
pranav: I'll own coordination and customer comms during canary.
maria: perfect. Closing notes: if any new blocker appears, post here and I'll triage. Will send a short cutover checklist tomorrow morning. :rocket:
